newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-BOLDEN EQUALS FASTEST TIME OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BOLDEN EQUALS FASTEST TIME OF YEAR.

text.p: Trinidad's Olympic 100 metres bronze medallist Ato Boldon equalled the fastest 60 metres time of the year on Sunday when he clocked 6.49 seconds at the Birminghan indoor grand prix.
Jamaican Michael Green is the only other man to have run as fast this season.
Nigerian Davidson Ezinwa was second in 6.53 and Jamaican Ray Stewart third in 6.55.
Canadian Bruny Surin, who attempts his third consecutive 60 metres indoor title in Paris next week, was eliminated in the heats, finishing seventh and last in the first heat.
Dennis Mitchell and Jon Drummond, both members of the U.S. 4x100 metres relay team who finished second to Canada at the Atlanta Olympics last year, also failed to qualify for the final.
